# glad

OpenGL loader generated by [glad 2.0.8](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) (header only):

```sh
glad --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions= --out-path . c --header-only
```

License of the generated file: `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0` (the Khronos XML specification
is Apache-2.0). The game player includes it with `GLAD_GL_IMPLEMENTATION`.
